name: Intendant des relais
description: Medium-height adult with broad shoulders, amber hide with dark lateral stripes, low swept-back crest, a few dreads tied on top, strong exposed mandibles. Short tan hooded cape with hood down, bronze collar plate, layered canvas trousers. Holds a folded heavy travel blanket and an angular bronze route compass at waist; rolled shelter poles strapped vertically beside compact backpack entirely below head. Ready-to-move stance.
